name: harness-workflow
description: Practical Codex workflow skills for Harness Builder, Spec, Executable Plan, scoped implementation, fresh verification, review, Knowledge Cleanup, and skill discovery.

interface.shortDescription: Daily project harness workflows for Codex.
interface.longDescription: Turns Learn Harness Engineering ideas into practical Codex skills for project-level Harness Builder, recovery surface design, Spec creation, Executable Plan writing, implementation, diagnosis, review, verification, Knowledge Cleanup, and project-fit skill discovery.
defaultPrompt: Use brainstorm to turn unclear requirements into an approved Spec with a verification strategy before planning.

Use harness-builder to design or repair the project harness and recovery surface: AGENTS.md, project map, iron laws, verification entry, Capability Discovery, justified skills, hooks, subagents, and MCP policy.
Use find-skills as the auxiliary skill-discovery helper when Capability Discovery needs reusable skills beyond the current plugin.
Use plan to create an Executable Plan in the selected planning surface: docs plan, issue, feature list, existing project system, or three-file backend.
Use verify to collect fresh evidence before claiming work is ready.
Use cleanup for Knowledge Cleanup: keep README, AGENTS.md, docs, generated artifacts, and recovery surface aligned.
